The total coordinate triples with entries in \(\{0,\frac12,1\}\) are \(3^3=27\).  
Exclude the 8 triples with no coordinate equal to \(\frac12\), since those are cube vertices and would require pairing a vertex with itself.  
Thus the number of valid equidistant points is \(27-8=19\).

\[
\boxed{19}
\]
